_note: Card modifiers (Yusuf, 2026-10-23): a dealt card rolls a rarity (roll in data/rarity.json) and a rolled card carries modifiers. Blue: one mark (data/marks.json). Yellow: a mark and one powerful modifier, sometimes two (card_mod_second_chance in data/balance.json). Orange: one transmutation, a trade-off that bends a rule of the town. Each entry here is a yellow or orange modifier: cards = the card kinds it can come on; roles (optional) = the roles it fits; needs_leaning = only on a card with a leaning. The townsperson keeps it for life (Unit.boons). Other cards (hero, spell, family, venture, trade) roll blue, yellow and orange modifiers from here too: blue one, yellow a yellow and a blue (sometimes two), orange one; needs_weapon, needs_give, needs_get, min_nights and spells limit which cards a modifier fits. cards [] = never dealt, only given (an exile). Townsfolk effect keys, summed with the mark's (FolkAI.unit_mod): hp, attack, speed (0.6 = 60% more), carry, gather_mult, build, upkeep (food beyond one person's share), band_weight (counts this many more toward their leaning's band), pick_bonus (dawn cards while they live), idle (never works: stays home), doom_rounds (dies at the end of the round this many rounds after arriving, counting that round), kin_chance (each dawn the chance a plain tribesperson joins free while there is room), kills (kills toward a warrior's promotion on arrival), twin (a second, plain one arrives too). Hero cards: levels, hound, weapon_tiers, cost_shells, legend (legend_levels up, a mythic item, legend_cost more; data/balance.json). Spell cards: nights (sooner), goods (left when done), lasts (a ridge's extra rounds), echo (happens twice), rest_rounds (no spell cards for that many rounds after). Family cards: extra_folk (role -> more), mark_members (that many arrive with a mark), goods, member_boon (every member carries it). Venture cards: gain_mult, safety (fewer lost), lose_all (nobody returns). Trade cards (odds trade_roll_mult): price_mult (on what you pay), get_mult (on the goods), goods (thrown in), linger (stays a round if not taken), extra_folk, wave_share (this round's attack grows by that share), curse_hero (a hero turns greedy). Blueprint and upgrade cards (slice 3; they last all run, so their numbers are about half the dawn ones) change the building's own numbers in this run, every one built or still to come: mult = shares added to numbers by dotted key (cost multiplies every resource; -1.0 makes it free), add = numbers added, both only to keys the building already has, so a modifier fits a building only when it has at least one of them (and every key in needs); grant = numbers added whether the building had them or not; min_max = only on buildings the town may have that many of; free_copy = drafting it also raises one for free at once. tags describe them for later rules. sim/card_roll.gd. short = the few words a card's modifier plaque shows beside its name (the card's hover shows text in full); an orange text reads "gift, but price" and the card shows the part after ", but " as the price.
